record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, augment the current pointwise logistic loss with 0.2*softplus(negative_score-positive_score), averaging the combined loss over the same valid target positions. Pointwise terms retain absolute score calibration, while the pairwise term directly encourages positive-negative separation relevant to ranking. Keep sampled examples, masking, architecture, embeddings, scoring, optimizer, scheduler and training settings unchanged; inference still uses one model per category.
record.diff_excerpt:
--- 
+++ 
@@ -156,5 +156,9 @@
     pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
     mask = (pos != 0).float()
-    loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+    loss = (
+        nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores)
+        + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
+        + 0.2 * nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
+    )
     return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

category_rationales.rationale: Add a pairwise ranking term weighted by 0.2 to the existing pointwise logistic loss across all four datasets. Preserve valid-position averaging, sampling, architecture, scoring, optimizer, training settings, and one checkpoint per category. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged.
